units.implementationStatus: Partial: merged PR2 supplies pinned managed intake service verification with explicit local non-owner identity mapping; it does not authenticate end users. PR3 snapshots trusted mappings and bounds credential/transport/body verification with cancellation, finite byte/chunk budgets, strict JSON UTF8 and sanitized failures. End-user federation, member provisioning and live host integration remain pending.

units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify normal behavior and rejection paths with source-bound automated evidence. Live acceptance is separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: PR4 durable policy/actor epochs and exact capability revocations with fixed host administrator configuration; PR5 five actual disposable PostgreSQL17 restricted-session scenarios passed final-head CI40573372927. PR6 adds Identity-owned dynamic member roles/disable/re-enable, unique permanent actor kinds, stored human-owner admission before cached lookup, last-owner protection and own-principal current-role resolution. Ten new restricted-migration groups, 39 ordinary tests/typecheck/build/registry pass. All three new TCP-session scenarios plus five existing regressions passed CI40583592826/job122469140267 on source3360465b182f95dff15aa66f960341bed99bfab6, logs inspected. All ten new groups also passed installed compiled public exports. Final-head acceptance remains separately required. Host authentication/provisioning, integrated current-policy action gateways, synchronization with separate capability revocations/other-engine policies, compartments and production/live qualification remain pending. Partial PR7: same-transaction membership/capability observation using shared internal verifier. Six new restricted-migration groups and all 45 local tests/typecheck/build/registry pass; installed package/current-head CI are separate. Existing eight TCP scenarios regress unchanged interfaces; no new combined-check network scenario. No external action fence, auto-epoch synchronization or HTTP host. All six new groups also pass installed compiled public exports; initial CI40589981411 passed check/postgres-contention. Final-head acceptance remains required. Partial PR8: four new combined MembershipRegistry.verifyCapability PostgreSQL-session cases hold real public member/revocation transactions before COMMIT, require independently observed lock waits, then deny disable/demotion/exact revocation/post-wait expiry despite forged incoming roles, with fresh-pool denial and audit checks. Local 45 ordinary tests and strict integration compile pass; actual twelve-group/final-head PostgreSQL17 CI remains required. No runtime/API/pin/contracts or production qualification change. All twelve groups (four new combined checks plus eight existing) passed CI40606559606/job122547398336 on sourcef03786b5459e7c5042f873421941835e7b6241b4, logs inspected; ordinary45 also passed. Final-head CI remains required after evidence update.
